import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,sysconfig,termios
configuration=termios.tcgetattr(sys.stdin.fileno())
configuration[3]&=~(termios.ECHO|termios.ICANON)
configuration[6][termios.VMIN]=1
configuration[6][termios.VTIME]=0
termios.tcsetattr(sys.stdin.fileno(),termios.TCSANOW,configuration)
root=pathlib.Path("/workspace/scratch/e870b2feaa97/native-segmentation-probe")
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
print("INPUT_READY",flush=True)
for line in sys.stdin:
    task=json.loads(line)
    for name,content in task.get("files",{}).items():
        path=root/name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(content,encoding="utf-8")
    if task.get("compile"):
        source=root/"memory_book/_native.c"
        output=root/"memory_book"/("_native"+sysconfig.get_config_var("EXT_SUFFIX"))
        command=["gcc","-shared","-fPIC","-O3","-Wall","-Wextra","-fwrapv",
                 "-I"+sysconfig.get_paths()["include"],str(source),"-o",str(output)]
        result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,text=True,capture_output=True)
        print("BUILD_EXIT",result.returncode,flush=True)
        if result.stdout:print(result.stdout,flush=True)
        if result.stderr:print(result.stderr,flush=True)
        if result.returncode:print("TASK_DONE",flush=True);continue
    if task.get("tests"):
        environment=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=str(root),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
        command=[sys.executable,"-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",task["tests"]]
        result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=environment,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=150)
        print("TEST_EXIT",result.returncode,flush=True)
        if result.stdout:print(result.stdout,flush=True)
        if result.stderr:print(result.stderr,flush=True)
    print("TASK_DONE",flush=True)
